en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a brick railway station building covered partly in ivy, with arched windows and a tiled roof. Several bicycles are parked along the facade and a small wooden kiosk or shed stands in the foreground where a woman and a child with a bicycle are present. Large tree branches frame the top of the image. Printed text at the bottom left names the place as Kattarp railway station, and a small logo with the word 'Pressbyrån' and the year 1937 appears at the lower right.
